## 4-Day Edinburgh Educational Trip Plan
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/building.svg

A budget-conscious, booking-friendly plan for **1 adult + 1 teenager** in Edinburgh from **2026-10-08 to 2026-10-11**.
I’ve kept the route centered on **Edinburgh Waverley / Princes Street** so hotel access is easy and daily transit stays low.

## Day-by-Day Itinerary and Cost Estimate
| Day | Focus | Planned stops | Est. cost |
|---|---|---|---|
| Day 1 | Science + old town | National Museum of Scotland; Old Town walk; bookshop stop at Armchair Books; free evening city stroll | **GBP 120** |
| Day 2 | Historic Edinburgh | Edinburgh Castle; Royal Mile; Scottish Storytelling Centre area; low-cost evening at a free museum talk or self-guided ghost walk | **GBP 170** |
| Day 3 | Science and books | Dynamic Earth; National Library area / Lighthouse Bookshop; Calton Hill sunset; casual supper | **GBP 155** |
| Day 4 | Final culture day | Palace of Holyroodhouse area or St Giles’ Cathedral; Waterstones on Princes Street; free evening riverside walk | **GBP 135** |

## Booking-Friendly 4-Day Edinburgh Itinerary
### Day 1: Museum start and Old Town introduction
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/geo-alt.svg
- Morning: Arrive, check in near **Edinburgh Waverley** or **Princes Street**.
- Afternoon: **National Museum of Scotland** for hands-on science, natural history, and Scottish collections.
- Bookshop: **Armchair Books** for a classic independent browse.
- Evening: **Free Old Town walk** from the Royal Mile to Victoria Street.
Media: Image=https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/1/11/Edinburgh_Old_Town_-_geograph.org.uk_-_7047112.jpg Alt=Evening: **Free Old Town walk** from the Royal Mile to Victoria Street, Edinburgh, Scotland
- Food: Budget takeaway or casual pub meal.
- Estimated total: **GBP 120**
  - Hotel: GBP 95
  - Food/transit: GBP 25

### Day 2: Historic Edinburgh core
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/building.svg
- Morning: **Edinburgh Castle** for the city’s main historic site.
- Afternoon: Walk the **Royal Mile** and stop at St Giles’ Cathedral exterior/interior if time allows.
- Bookshop: Browse **West Port Bookshop** or a nearby second-hand shop if open.
- Evening: **Low-cost activity**: self-guided ghost walk, Arthur’s Seat viewpoint at dusk, or a free talk if scheduled.
- Food: Sandwich lunch + simple dinner.
- Estimated total: **GBP 170**
  - Castle tickets: GBP 60
  - Hotel: GBP 95
  - Food/transit: GBP 15

### Day 3: Science and skyline
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/thermometer-half.svg
- Morning: **Dynamic Earth** for an interactive science-focused visit.
- Afternoon: Bookshop stop at **Lighthouse Bookshop** or another central indie bookshop.
- Evening: **Calton Hill** for sunset and city views, then a low-cost dinner.
- Food: Café lunch and budget dinner.
- Estimated total: **GBP 155**
  - Dynamic Earth tickets: GBP 40
  - Hotel: GBP 95
  - Food/transit: GBP 20

### Day 4: Final heritage and reading day
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/book.svg
- Morning: **Palace of Holyroodhouse area** or **St Giles’ Cathedral** depending on interest and ticket budget.
- Afternoon: **Waterstones Princes Street** for a reliable final bookshop stop and souvenir-free browse.
- Evening: **Free Water of Leith / Princes Street Gardens walk** before departure.
- Food: Light lunch and train-station dinner/snack.
- Estimated total: **GBP 135**
  - Attraction or donation-based entry: GBP 20
  - Hotel: GBP 95
  - Food/transit: GBP 20

## Budget Check and Hotel Shortlist
### Recommended stay pattern
- **3 nights** near **Edinburgh Waverley** is the best fit for your budget and route.
- Target hotel budget: **GBP 85–110 per night** for a twin/double room that works for 2 travelers.
- Best value areas: **Waverley / Princes Street / Old Town edge**.
Media: Image=https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/8/80/2010-11-04_13-43-15_United_Kingdom_Scotland_Edinburgh_HDR.jpg Alt=Best value areas: **Waverley / Princes Street / Old Town edge**, Edinburgh, Scotland

### Shortlist for lodging near the train station
- **Point A Hotel Edinburgh Haymarket** — good budget value, easy transport access, often cheaper than Old Town.
- **YOTEL Edinburgh** — central, modern, convenient for station access.
- **Premier Inn Edinburgh City Centre** — dependable mid-budget choice when available.
- **Hub by Premier Inn Edinburgh City Centre** — compact rooms, strong location, usually efficient for short stays.

### Total trip estimate
- **Hotel (3 nights): GBP 255–330**
- **Attractions/entry: GBP 80–120**
- **Food and local transit: GBP 180–240**
- **Total estimated spend: GBP 515–690**

This leaves a healthy buffer under your **GBP 900** cap for upgraded meals, extra admissions, or a taxi if needed.

## What to Reserve Before You Go
- **Hotel near Edinburgh Waverley** for all 3 nights
- **Edinburgh Castle timed entry**
- **Dynamic Earth tickets**
- **Palace of Holyroodhouse** if you want the royal-historic option
- **Train tickets** if your arrival/departure times are fixed
- Optional: any paid evening event, especially around October when schedules can fill
